The middle rack has an odd layout that does not hold glasses in place. Unless the rack is fully packed, glasses can fall over and fill with dirty washing water. It's nice that the middle rack can be moved up or down but I've found that if I move it down to be able to wash tall glasses, it is too low for the sprayer arm to spin without getting stuck on standard dinner plates. The third/top rack seems like a really great idea but it also contributes to the height problem with the bottom and middle rack. My preference would be a narrow utensil basket mounted on the door instead of the third rack. Note that this dishwasher is actually 23.5" wide which caused and awkward gap that we still have to fill. If the middle rack had a better design and the height problem was resolved this dishwasher would be 5/5.

Sentence (English): First time Bosch buyer after many other brands lasted only a few years.
Comments (English): [ Cleans GREAT, but a few disappointments. ] || ---------------- || First time Bosch buyer after many other brands lasted only a few years. Very pleased with the end result of cleaning and sanitizing. Racks have unusual setup for adding dishes. Utensil baskets have no place for larger utensils (must lay flat on one of the two upper racks) and the lack of a front screen to give the cycle status is something I won't accept again. Yes, I knew there was no screen when I purchased, and knew I would only have a "red light" shining on the floor while running, but the inability to know how much longer is left in the cycle is disappointing. But that's on me. Overall, a very nice, capable and workable machine, but I will definitely look at the baskets, racks and have a front screen on my next purchase. If you can get buy without having my concerns, this machine is definitely for you!

I created a second repair in October but again the repair could not be scheduled in time. Whirlpool extended my warranty for 6 months. I created a 3rd repair ticket and Whirlpool was unable to find a repair person who could come to our home to replace the panel. We bought this to replace our 15 year old dishwasher (trouble free) and had no issues in the beginning but after about 10 months I noticed bubbling hardwood floor in the living room. After much investigation I pinned it down to this leaky dishwasher but it was too late and the damage was already done to the property. I contacted Costco as it was under original manufacturer warranty but they were unable to help and referred me to the manufacturer. The manufacturer, Whirlpool (yes, Whirlpool), agreed to investigate and also agreed to cover the damages BUT they asked me to prove the dishwasher leaked and provide the part that was replaced to fix the dishwasher. At the end I gave up and then I had to use my homeowners insurance to cover the cost. It is a shame that these manufacturers cannot detect leak from dishwasher that can alarm the homeowner before any damage is done. And asking homeowners to jump hoops after hoops to cover damages is another insult to injury.

Sentence (English): I've used and/or owned quite a number of dishwashers over my 65 years and this one is the best one by far.
Comments (English): [ Best Dishwasher I've owned ] || ---------------- || I've used and/or owned quite a number of dishwashers over my 65 years and this one is the best one by far. It was installed as part of a kitchen remodel I did myself. This dishwasher is super quiet (even before the countertops were installed) and, so far, cleans all the dishes very well with only one detergent tablet. All the dishes and silverware consistently come out spotless. I love the third top rack for sliverware. Everything is held in place without touching each other and very easy to unload. I thought our water was pretty soft as we haven't needed a water softener but the test strip that came with the installation instructions said we had 1.9-2.1 mmol/l of hardness. Setting the dishwasher to H:03 was very easy with the phone app. I'm really glad we went for the model with the integrated water softener. I'm an engineer and long time home improvement DIY'er that gets great gratification from things built or installed plumb, level with precision. While I've installed a number of dishwashers in the past, I've never installed a Bosch dishwasher let alone one with an appliance panel. Here are two areas that I could see where the installation instructions could use improvement: 1.The instructions to install the appliance panel to the door of the dishwasher are clear on how to fasten it to the dishwaser door but they're not clear on the limits of the maximum height of the panel or how to align the panel so the bottom edge will be level with the doors on the rest of the cabinets. There are diagrams that look like they're trying to show the dimensions and limits but a little text to go along with the diagrams would help clarify what the diagrams are trying to say. I had to resort to downloading the 3D CAD model from Bosch to get dimensions for how the top of the appliance panel aligns with the top of the door. 2. The dishwasher is made to fit under a wide range of counter heights. Our base cabinets were 34.5 inches tall leaving quite a bit of room above the dishwasher. Sentence (English): I've used and/or owned quite a number of dishwashers over my 65 years and this one is the best one by far.
Comments (English): [ Best Dishwasher I've owned ] || ---------------- || I've used and/or owned quite a number of dishwashers over my 65 years and this one is the best one by far. It was installed as part of a kitchen remodel I did myself. This dishwasher is super quiet (even before the countertops were installed) and, so far, cleans all the dishes very well with only one detergent tablet. All the dishes and silverware consistently come out spotless. I love the third top rack for sliverware. Everything is held in place without touching each other and very easy to unload.I thought our water was pretty soft as we haven't needed a water softener but the test strip that came with the installation instructions said we had 1.9-2.1 mmol/l of hardness. Setting the dishwasher to H:03 was very easy with the phone app. I'm really glad we went for the model with the integrated water softener. I'm an engineer and long time home improvement DIY'er that gets great gratification from things built or installed plumb, level with precision.While I've installed a number of dishwashers in the past, I've never installed a Bosch dishwasher let alone one with an appliance panel. Here are two areas that I could see where the installation instructions could use improvement:1.The instructions to install the appliance panel to the door of the dishwasher are clear on how to fasten it to the dishwaser door but they're not clear on the limits of the maximum height of the panel or how to align the panel so the bottom edge will be level with the doors on the rest of the cabinets. There are diagrams that look like they're trying to show the dimensions and limits but a little text to go along with the diagrams would help clarify what the diagrams are trying to say. I had to resort to downloading the 3D CAD model from Bosch to get dimensions for how the top of the appliance panel aligns with the top of the door.2. The dishwasher is made to fit under a wide range of counter heights. Our base cabinets were 34.5 inches tall leaving quite a bit of room above the dishwasher. We could have adjusted the feet to close that gap but the bottom edge of the appliance panel wouldn't align properly. The photo of an installed SGV78B53UC on the Bosch website showed a filler strip above the appliance panel which would work great but the installation instructions don't adress this in words. Once I found a small add-in sheet with the instructions it made things a bit clearer as to how to install blocking to prevent the diswasher from tipping forward when installed under tall countertops. It again, only had diagrams and no text to clarify.I would certainly recommend this dishwasher to anyone but if you're having installed, make sure the installer has experience installing Bosch diswashers. Especially so for dishwashers with the appliance panel option.

Sentence (English): I've came at this review after using various programs and different items in the dishwasher; its too easy to gush over a product you've just bought just to justify why you bought it.
Comments (English): [ Impressed. ] || ---------------- || I've came at this review after using various programs and different items in the dishwasher; its too easy to gush over a product you've just bought just to justify why you bought it. Firstly I couldn't find a Series 8 in any store locally. So to get an idea of how it felt I took a look at a Series 6. So it was a bit of a leap of faith to pay for an "8" based on doing this and looking at other reviews online. It feels very solidly built; the racks, controls and door. Compared to the 13 year old machine from another manufacturer it replaced it also looks rather classy in the stainless steel finish. But how does it do cleaning? Exceedingly well. Using quality cleaning products helps but I can say that there is nothing that has been washed that I didn't feel was anything less than spotlessly clean when I took it out at the end. It uses so little energy and water to do it too. This is my first time using a third, top, cutlery tray and I thought it would just waste space in the machine. It doesn't. Loading and unloading cutlery is a lot easier than the chicken peck method you have to do to put cutlery into and out of a cutlery basket. The choice of different loading options, by using the various folding racks that are clearly marked in red, is good. This is the first dishwasher I've ever used that actually dries plastic, completely. It sounds silly to have say that. The Zeolith drying really makes a massive difference to all those plastic jugs and food containers that I had to finish off with a dish towel in the past. The connected app works well and is clear to use. Pros: It cleans and dries very well. The drying in particular is on a different level to anything I've had before. Quality feel and design. Controls are very intuitive to use and the screens are informative and clear. Very energy and water efficient for what it can do. It'll save money in the long run compared to what I had before. So quiet, I can't imagine ever using the "Silence" program Cons: It was expensive. That has to be a con right? Not really. I could also place this under the "Pros" as good value for money. If someone blind folded me and replaced this with my previous washer I WOULD immediately know the difference. I'm looking to buy a new built in oven in the next couple of months and based on my experience with this product it'll be a Bosch. I would recommend the Series 8 for anyone looking for a quality washer, with excellent results.

Firstly I couldn't find a Series 8 in any store locally. So to get an idea of how it felt I took a look at a Series 6. So it was a bit of a leap of faith to pay for an "8" based on doing this and looking at other reviews online. It feels very solidly built; the racks, controls and door. Compared to the 13 year old machine from another manufacturer it replaced it also looks rather classy in the stainless steel finish. But how does it do cleaning? Exceedingly well. Using quality cleaning products helps but I can say that there is nothing that has been washed that I didn't feel was anything less than spotlessly clean when I took it out at the end. It uses so little energy and water to do it too. This is my first time using a third, top, cutlery tray and I thought it would just waste space in the machine. It doesn't. Loading and unloading cutlery is a lot easier than the chicken peck method you have to do to put cutlery into and out of a cutlery basket. The choice of different loading options, by using the various folding racks that are clearly marked in red, is good. This is the first dishwasher I've ever used that actually dries plastic, completely. It sounds silly to have say that. The Zeolith drying really makes a massive difference to all those plastic jugs and food containers that I had to finish off with a dish towel in the past. The connected app works well and is clear to use. Pros: It cleans and dries very well. The drying in particular is on a different level to anything I've had before. Quality feel and design. Controls are very intuitive to use and the screens are informative and clear. Very energy and water efficient for what it can do. It'll save money in the long run compared to what I had before. So quiet, I can't imagine ever using the "Silence" program Cons: It was expensive. That has to be a con right? Not really. I could also place this under the "Pros" as good value for money. If someone blind folded me and replaced this with my previous washer I WOULD immediately know the difference. I'm looking to buy a new built in oven in the next couple of months and based on my experience with this product it'll be a Bosch. I would recommend the Series 8 for anyone looking for a quality washer, with excellent results.

Sentence (English): Every time I use my new Whirlpool dishwasher, I promise myself that I will write a review because I am so happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Great Choice for the Money ] || ---------------- || Every time I use my new Whirlpool dishwasher, I promise myself that I will write a review because I am so happy with it. Here I am, finally, after using it for 3 months. I should start by telling you that I was replacing a 15 year old Whirlpool that was still limping along but very loud and outdated. I didn't want a high end dishwasher, but I wanted an appliance that would be user friendly, easy to load, and quieter than the old one. This Whirlpool seemed to fit the bill. First of all, that 3rd rack is a game changer. I love it and use it all the time for larger utensils as well as to clean my scrubbers and sponges. I had no idea how much space it saves having that rack. The top rack is adjustable, and I keep it low because you can fit so many things up there that otherwise would be taking up real estate in the bottom rack: glass tea pitchers, sports bottles, tall tumblers, etc., fit nicely and free up space on the bottom. However, it is easy to move that rack up to accommodate bigger things below. There are adjustments to be made on the bottom rack as well, depending on what you're cooking today. Even the utensil rack has so many options for different sizes. Whoever designs Whirlpools is doing a great job because I am continually amazed at how much stuff I can fit in that thing. Don't rinse your dishes! Honestly, do not. They will come clean. Everything from that crappy oatmeal encrusted bowl to the rice pot that boiled over to the dish your spouse used to microwave the leftover pizza and then forgot to at least soak (ggrrr. ). They will get clean, sparkly, and pretty dry. Not totally dry. People complained about that so I did not have high expectations, but on the full cycle it does get stuff like 85% there. The quick cycle doesn't dry them at all. It's a trade off for clean dishes in a short time, and I use it for really small loads I just need to get done. It is pretty quiet. Not silent. But for the price, I am quite happy with the low noise level. The controls are easy and quickly become second nature. It feels sturdy and secure. It's an attractive appliance and will look great in your kitchen. No fingerprints! The bottom line here is that, for a fairly reasonable price compared to others on display, you are getting a great appliance that works well and looks pretty good inside and out. Are there better choices out there for more money? Sure. I guess so. But this delivered exactly what I wanted, no more no less, and for the price I was willing to spend.

Sentence (English): We were very glad to unpack the LG dishwasher and see it was in perfect shape….no damage like the last one (not a LG) we received.
Comments (English): [ LG Top Control LDTH7972S ] || ---------------- || We were very glad to unpack the LG dishwasher and see it was in perfect shape….no damage like the last one (not a LG) we received. I will have to say LG packs their dishwashers very well. I removed the old Kitchenaid that had started leaking from the float stem and switch area. The LG water and electrical connections were a little different than the Kitchenaid, but did not present any major issues. Installation was straightforward with one exception…the installation instructions of the front rubber sound blanket was not very clear. I found a YouTube video that explained and provided the instructions needed. The fingerprint-proof stainless exterior is very nice….much better than our old dishwasher that seemed to need cleaning on a daily basis. This dishwasher is extremely quiet and you have to listen closely to hear it running. Hearing the water draining through the garbage disposal side inlet is the noisiest of all the cycles. The one disappointment of this LG compared with our old Kitchenaid is internal rack capacity. The LG racks and the silverware basket are smaller than our old dishwasher. Both my wife and I noticed this. Puzzled, we compared and noticed the gap between the rack edges to the interior stainless surface was larger in the LG…. but, overall we are very pleased thus far with this LG. It cleans very well, is very quiet, has many more wash settings than we will ever use, and easy to clean. It even connects to your wifi and lets you know when it is finished cleaning!

Sentence (English): The first thing to note is that the dishwasher is very quiet.
Comments (English): [ The evolution of household appliances ] || ---------------- || The first thing to note is that the dishwasher is very quiet. It has 3 trays: The upper one for cutlery. The middle one is height adjustable. In the lower tray you can fold the "skewers" of the dishes and thus enter pots or casseroles. Everything comes out spotless. I have used without and with the steam function, and I stay with steam. Add a plus of hygiene (that adds a few minutes to the wash). Of 10 the function of opening the door when finished, this eliminates many water marks on the dishes by immediately releasing the steam. The only con I find is the app. I expected that I could configure the washes and start it (and avoid the touch area of the device) but as far as I have seen, it is only for information. If they improve this (or find a way to do it), I'd be happy. It has compatibility with smart speakers that notify you when the wash has finished. With this integration you can schedule the purchase of tablets and dishwashers.
Comments (Original): [ La evolución de los electrodomésticos ] || ---------------- || Lo primero que destaco es que el lavavajillas es muy silencioso. Cuenta con 3 bandejas: La superior para cubiertos. La del medio es regulable en altura. En la bandeja inferior se pueden plegar los 'pinchitos' de los platos y así entran ollas o cazuelas. Sale todo impoluto. He usado sin y con la función de vapor, y me quedo con vapor. Añade un plus de higiene (eso le añade unos cuantos minutos al lavado). De 10 la función de abrir la puerta al terminar, con esto se elimina muchas marcas de agua en la vajilla al liberar inmediatamente el vapor. El único contra que le encuentro es la app. Yo me esperaba que pudiese configurar los lavados y ponerlo en marcha (y evitar la zona táctil del aparato) pero hasta lo que yo he visto, solo es a modo de información. Si mejoran esto (o encuentro como hacerlo), sería feliz. Tiene compatibilidad con altavoces inteligentes que te avisan cuando ha terminado el lavado. Con esta integración se puede programar la compra de pastillas y lavavajillas.

Sentence (English): Every time I use my new Whirlpool dishwasher, I promise myself that I will write a review because I am so happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Great Choice for the Money ] || ---------------- || Every time I use my new Whirlpool dishwasher, I promise myself that I will write a review because I am so happy with it. Here I am, finally, after using it for 3 months. I should start by telling you that I was replacing a 15 year old Whirlpool that was still limping along but very loud and outdated. I didn't want a high end dishwasher, but I wanted an appliance that would be user friendly, easy to load, and quieter than the old one. This Whirlpool seemed to fit the bill.First of all, that 3rd rack is a game changer. I love it and use it all the time for larger utensils as well as to clean my scrubbers and sponges. I had no idea how much space it saves having that rack. The top rack is adjustable, and I keep it low because you can fit so many things up there that otherwise would be taking up real estate in the bottom rack: glass tea pitchers, sports bottles, tall tumblers, etc., fit nicely and free up space on the bottom. However, it is easy to move that rack up to accommodate bigger things below.There are adjustments to be made on the bottom rack as well, depending on what you're cooking today. Even the utensil rack has so many options for different sizes. Whoever designs Whirlpools is doing a great job because I am continually amazed at how much stuff I can fit in that thing. Don't rinse your dishes! Honestly, do not. They will come clean. Everything from that crappy oatmeal encrusted bowl to the rice pot that boiled over to the dish your spouse used to microwave the leftover pizza and then forgot to at least soak (ggrrr. ). They will get clean, sparkly, and pretty dry. Not totally dry. People complained about that so I did not have high expectations, but on the full cycle it does get stuff like 85% there. The quick cycle doesn't dry them at all. It's a trade off for clean dishes in a short time, and I use it for really small loads I just need to get done. It is pretty quiet. Not silent. But for the price, I am quite happy with the low noise level. The controls are easy and quickly become second nature. It feels sturdy and secure.It's an attractive appliance and will look great in your kitchen. No fingerprints! The bottom line here is that, for a fairly reasonable price compared to others on display, you are getting a great appliance that works well and looks pretty good inside and out. Are there better choices out there for more money? Sure. I guess so. But this delivered exactly what I wanted, no more no less, and for the price I was willing to spend.

Sentence (English): I have been using the dishwasher for 2 weeks, my conclusions: Baskets: They are very practical.
Comments (English): [ Cleaning and Drying for perfect crockery ] || ---------------- || I have been using the dishwasher for 2 weeks, my conclusions: Baskets: They are very practical. Contains 3 baskets. A superior one for cutlery, it costs a bit to use at first, but when you organize it; spoons, forks etc is very practical, when I take out the cutlery I already have them organized. An intermediate one for glasses, tuppers and small objects. It contains 2 positions, one higher and one lower, if you add tall things, in this basket or in the lower one, you will not hit the blades of the dishwasher. This option is very useful and easy to use, with finger-shaped handles that make it easy to change positions. A lower basket, which does not contain a cutlery basket (upper basket), which gives it plenty of space for dishes or if you fold the skewers, for objects such as saucepans, paella pans (used and 10). Programs: it has a variety of programs: Eco, Rinse, Delicate, Auto, so you can choose according to the content to be washed. I usually use Eco, although the program is longer, I like the option to save energy and water. To this program I add the Steam option so that the glasses come out shiny. And indeed they come out clear and without stains. And the best thing for me is that at the end of the program the door opens to finish drying the dishes! Cal Regulation Option: Makes your dishwasher use more or less salt depending on your geographical area. You have to indicate it at the beginning of the use, so that it softens the water and is no longer hard, which avoids the annoying remains of Lime. I live in an area with hard water, and it is perfect for me. Program Download Option: It comes with the option to download an APP to manage the dishwasher from your mobile. The useful thing about this application is that it tells you the number of washes you have and when to clean the tub. It also contains program delay to choose when it ends. Disadvantage: It is too tactile and sensitive, and since I have little ones I always have to lock the dishwasher panel so that they do not modify anything. Of course, the Screen Lock is appreciated.
Comments (Original): [ Limpieza y Secado para una vajilla perfecta ] || ---------------- || Llevo 2 semanas utilizando el lavavajillas, mis conclusiones: Cestos: Son muy prácticos. Contiene 3 cestos. Uno superior para cubiertos, al principio cuesta un poco de usar, pero cuando lo organizas; cucharas, tenedores etc es muy práctico, al sacar los cubiertos ya los tengo organizados. Uno intermedio para vasos, tuppers y objetos pequeños. Contiene 2 posiciones, uno más alto y otro más bajo, si añades cosas altas, en esta cesta o en la inferior, no golpeas las aspas del lavavajillas. Esta opción es muy útil y fácil de usar, con asas con forma de dedos que hace sencillo cambiar de posición. Un cesto inferior, que no contiene cesto de cubiertos (cesto superior), lo que le da mucho espacio para platos o si pliegas los pinchos, para objetos como cacerolas, paelleras (usado y de 10). Programas: tiene variedad de programas: Eco, Aclarado, Delicado, Auto, para que elijas según el contenido a lavar. Yo suelo usar Eco que aunque es más largo el programa, me gusta la opción de ahorro de energía y agua. A este programa le añado la opción Vapor para que los vasos salgan relucientes. Y efectivamente salen claros y sin manchas. Y lo Mejor para mí, es que al final del programa la puerta se abre para que se termine de secar la vajilla!! Opción Regulación de Cal: Hace que tu lavavajillas use más o menos sal en función de tu zona geográfica. Tienes que indicarle al principio del uso, para que ablande el agua y ya no sea dura, lo que evita los molestos restos de Cal. Yo vivo en zona de agua dura, y es perfecto para mí. Opción Descarga de Programas: Viene con opción de bajar una APP para gestionar el lavavajillas desde tu móvil. De esta aplicación lo útil es que te indica el nº de lavados que llevas y cuando limpiar la cuba. Además contiene retardo de programas para elegir cuando termina. Inconveniente: Es demasiado táctil y sensible, y yo que tengo peques tengo que bloquear siempre el cuadro del lavavajillas para que no modifiquen nada. Eso sí se agradece el Bloqueo de Pantalla.

Sentence (English): I've had an abundance of GE appliances and a couple dishwashers over the past couple years and I have to say this one is my least favorite of all.
Comments (English): [ Meh ] || ---------------- || I've had an abundance of GE appliances and a couple dishwashers over the past couple years and I have to say this one is my least favorite of all. The top rack is good fits small dishes most cups and other things however the bottom rack is an absolute horrible design. Plates stack fine, and the silverware compartment is adequate but trying to arrange other dishes such as bowls, food storage containers (Tupperware) and an array of medium sized Pyrex glassware. Nothing stands up properly so it can drain whatever water is used to wash it everything falls. Years ago I had a low end GE stainless steel profile dishwasher in the bottom rack is a perfect design fit all my dishes perfectly. And after having it sometime I'm not terribly pleased with the controls placement. It is nice to be able to see how much time is left on a running dishwasher if you're waiting for something. Also when sitting for a delay wash occasionally you find you need to add other things and every time you open the door you have to depressed the start button. If by chance you open it mid cycle to add or remove something you have to push the start button for it to continue otherwise it just constantly beeps at you. The older style were great if you opened it mid cycle once you close the door it started back up again. And lastly I feel the deletion of the rotating sprayer in the top for the top rack has diminished it's cleaning properties.

Sentence (English): I thought I loved my Kenmore, but good grief this gets dishes clean!
Comments (English): [ WOW! ] || ---------------- || I thought I loved my Kenmore, but good grief this gets dishes clean! I gave a not so good review a few months ago, but have since changed my mind. I did not like the evaporation drying, but now think it's fine. The good thing, is it doesn't melt anything. Loading seems fine, and love the 3rd rack at the top for spatulas, etc. I will not take the time to put silverware in it tho. I just cannot get over how clean and sparkling my dishes are. Even if I put a casserole in, it'll get the thing totally clean-- always helps if you spray everything before cooking. My glasses always had a film on them, so I use the Puracy from Amazon and Cascade rinse. They are so sparkling and clear that I'm in shock. May look for a rinse without sulfates. Don't love how hard it is to program, which would be my only complaint. My dishwasher came with every option 2 1/2 hrs, so need to get somebody out to fix that. My Speed60 which is supposed to an hr, is 1 1/2 hrs. I wish it was 1 hr, but that cycle gets everything super clean. The extra dry made things wetter, so I don't even use that cycle. Cleaning the filter is super easy. My door shuts loud, which I don't think is right. Lady at Bosch customer service had no idea and was just reading the manual for any questions. It is expensive, but wow, what a great dishwasher!

Sentence (English): The kitchen of my mother-in-law's house is relatively small, and I can only use countertops (14 sets in my own home).
Comments (English): The kitchen of my mother-in-law's house is relatively small, and I can only use countertops (14 sets in my own home). After seeing Midea UP2 and Mi S1, I finally chose Panasonic. Although the price is the highest and the height of the fuselage is also the highest, after the arrival, it is confirmed that the choice is correct. The internal space and flexibility are very good, especially the design of the bowl basket is very suitable for the shape of the dishes and the dining habits of the mother-in-law. Put as many bowls as possible. After discussing with the master, I decisively drilled holes for the inlet and outlet pipes under the sink, and the countertop was extremely clean. For the consumables, I chose Shuiweishi 10g dishwashing block, and the activity price can be as low as 0.35 yuan, just stock up hard. There is no need to think about whether the washing is clean. As long as the machine is fine, there is no need to worry about the cleanliness. The only downside is that there is no reminder of the remaining time, and I hope that subsequent models can be improved.
Comments (Original): 岳母家厨房比较小，只能用台上式的（我自己家用的14套）。看了美的UP2，小米S1，最终还是选择了松下。尽管价格是最高的、机身高度也是最高的，但是到货后确定没有选错，内部空间和灵活度很好，特别是碗篮的设计很适合岳母家的碗碟形态和用餐习惯，可以尽可能多的放碗。和师傅商量后，果断的将进排水管都打洞穿到水槽下面，台面无比整洁。耗材选了水卫仕10g的洗碗块，活动价最低可以做到0.35元左右，使劲囤货就对了。是否洗的干净，根本不用去考虑，只要机器没问题，干净程度根本不用担心。唯一不足的是没有剩余时间提示，希望后续机型可以改进。

Then, the second item; the strain relief clearly says "to fit 7/8"(22mm) hole". Well, the parts in stock were listed as 1/2" and 3/4". The assistant manager and I decided that the flange and nut were large enough to still pull up tight on a 7/8" diameter hole. So I get home and guess what, the 3/4" SR doesn't fit through the hole. At this point I decided to just enlarge the hole. I chucked a grind stone in my drill motor and began grinding until the hole was large enough to take the SR.I added a pic of the grind stone when I was done. It used to be cone shaped. As for how well the DW works, that is for a later date.

Sentence (English): (This review has been received through a promotion.)
Comments (English): [ Cleaning and Drying for perfect crockery ] || ---------------- || (This review has been received through a promotion.) I have been using the dishwasher for 2 weeks, my conclusions: Baskets: They are very practical. Contains 3 baskets. A superior one for cutlery, it costs a bit to use at first, but when you organize it; spoons, forks etc is very practical, when I take out the cutlery I already have them organized. An intermediate one for glasses, tuppers and small objects. It contains 2 positions, one higher and one lower, if you add tall things, in this basket or in the lower one, you will not hit the blades of the dishwasher. This option is very useful and easy to use, with finger-shaped handles that make it easy to change positions. A lower basket, which does not contain a cutlery basket (upper basket), which gives it plenty of space for dishes or if you fold the skewers, for objects such as saucepans, paella pans (used and 10). Programs: it has a variety of programs: Eco, Rinse, Delicate, Auto, so you can choose according to the content to be washed. I usually use Eco, although the program is longer, I like the option to save energy and water. To this program I add the Steam option so that the glasses come out shiny. And indeed they come out clear and without stains. And the best thing for me is that at the end of the program the door opens to finish drying the dishes! Cal Regulation Option: Makes your dishwasher use more or less salt depending on your geographical area. You have to indicate it at the beginning of the use, so that it softens the water and is no longer hard, which avoids the annoying remains of Lime. I live in an area with hard water, and it is perfect for me. Program Download Option: It comes with the option to download an APP to manage the dishwasher from your mobile. The useful thing about this application is that it tells you the number of washes you have and when to clean the tub. It also contains program delay to choose when it ends. Disadvantage: It is too tactile and sensitive, and since I have little ones I always have to lock the dishwasher panel so that they do not modify anything. Of course, the Screen Lock is appreciated.
Comments (Original): [ Limpieza y Secado para una vajilla perfecta ] || ---------------- || (Esta reseña se ha recibido a través de una promoción.) Llevo 2 semanas utilizando el lavavajillas, mis conclusiones: Cestos: Son muy prácticos. Contiene 3 cestos. Uno superior para cubiertos, al principio cuesta un poco de usar, pero cuando lo organizas; cucharas, tenedores etc es muy práctico, al sacar los cubiertos ya los tengo organizados. Uno intermedio para vasos, tuppers y objetos pequeños. Contiene 2 posiciones, uno más alto y otro más bajo, si añades cosas altas, en esta cesta o en la inferior, no golpeas las aspas del lavavajillas. Esta opción es muy útil y fácil de usar, con asas con forma de dedos que hace sencillo cambiar de posición. Un cesto inferior, que no contiene cesto de cubiertos (cesto superior), lo que le da mucho espacio para platos o si pliegas los pinchos, para objetos como cacerolas, paelleras (usado y de 10). Programas: tiene variedad de programas: Eco, Aclarado, Delicado, Auto, para que elijas según el contenido a lavar. Yo suelo usar Eco que aunque es más largo el programa, me gusta la opción de ahorro de energía y agua. A este programa le añado la opción Vapor para que los vasos salgan relucientes. Y efectivamente salen claros y sin manchas. Y lo Mejor para mí, es que al final del programa la puerta se abre para que se termine de secar la vajilla!! Opción Regulación de Cal: Hace que tu lavavajillas use más o menos sal en función de tu zona geográfica. Tienes que indicarle al principio del uso, para que ablande el agua y ya no sea dura, lo que evita los molestos restos de Cal. Yo vivo en zona de agua dura, y es perfecto para mí. Opción Descarga de Programas: Viene con opción de bajar una APP para gestionar el lavavajillas desde tu móvil. De esta aplicación lo útil es que te indica el nº de lavados que llevas y cuando limpiar la cuba. Además contiene retardo de programas para elegir cuando termina. Inconveniente: Es demasiado táctil y sensible, y yo que tengo peques tengo que bloquear siempre el cuadro del lavavajillas para que no modifiquen nada. Eso sí se agradece el Bloqueo de Pantalla.

Sentence (English): We purchased this model to replace a Kitchenaid that lasted 20 years and we have owned many Kitchenaid products over the years.
Comments (English): [ Good but some drawbacks ] || ---------------- || We purchased this model to replace a Kitchenaid that lasted 20 years and we have owned many Kitchenaid products over the years. The previous model had fold-able tine rows on the second level that allowed for flexibility with some odd ball glasses, bowls and storage ware. The new design limits some of this as the rows are fixed and the stability of objects placed upright is not as good. Stemware in the older model was easily accommodated by a slotted holder that folded down over a section of the row and held the wine glasses in nicely. The bottom tray, of the newer model is spacious and one of the only drawbacks to the silverware holder/basket is that the top of it is always still wet even after extended drying function. Our one other chief quirk is the lack/removal of the countdown clock on the front display of the old modelWe were limiting ourselves to a white replacement and would have opted for a higher model if available in whiteOn the plus side the new unit is very quiet and does a good job of cleaning and sanitizingWe would still choose Kitchenaid products in the future

I really like LG products (except their Linear compressors), but this time can only give this 3 stars.

Sentence (English): I've been using it for about 3 weeks.
Comments (English): [ I've been using it for about 3 weeks. We are a family of 3, and as you can see in the attached photo, all the dishes in the sink are included. If you look at other reviews, there are good points, so it's good to refer to them. ] || ---------------- || I've been using it for about 3 weeks. We are a family of 3, and as you can see in the attached photo, all the dishes in the sink are included. If you look at other reviews, the good points are well written, so it would be nice to refer to them, and I will write only the regrettable points. 1. Noise related. - It seems that the noise is louder than the sink sub-cabinet buried dishwasher (12 people) that I used before. Aside from the sound of water, the intermittent pump operation sound is quite annoying. Others say it is quiet, but it seems that there are individual differences. 2. Capacity-related. - Small plates and bowls are usually enough for a family of three. The problem is a little big plate or cooking utensils. This part is probably for 6 people, so don't expect too much. 3. Others. - It has an upper rotary wing, which is an advantage over other companies' products, but if you want to put these wings in it, you can't stack them high or put them in the lower cabinet. I guess I'll have to learn how to use it more. Still, I have an aunt who helps me, and my wife really likes it. ^^

Comments (English): [ Disappointed ] || ---------------- || Our home was flooded in 2017 when hurricane Irma hit our area. We bought a KitchenAid dishwasher because of the high rating. We loved it - never had a problem with it. When we were flooded with hurricane Nichole in November of 2022, we again bought a KitchenAid dishwasher. It was installed on February of 2023 after the cabinets and sink was installed. From the begining I always had to dry the dishes off after the cycle was finished. The 3rd week of April the dishwasher stopped in the middle of the cycle - I tried to turn it back on but there was no power. My husband called and a service person from Fields Appliance called to say he will be the one servicing it. He checked it and said the Electric Control was not working and another had to be ordered. I also addressed the drying problem and was told I HAVE to use the rinse aid -I did not have the problem in the past when I didn't use the rinse aid but when it is repaired I will try his suggestion. After a couple of weeks I called Fields Appliancewho said the part is expected to arrive on May 26. I have been going through Breast Cancer for the last two years and this has just made it harder for me to keep the house in order.

Sentence (English): We purchased this model to replace a Kitchenaid that lasted 20 years and we have owned many Kitchenaid products over the years.
Comments (English): [ Good but some drawbacks ] || ---------------- || We purchased this model to replace a Kitchenaid that lasted 20 years and we have owned many Kitchenaid products over the years. The previous model had fold-able tine rows on the second level that allowed for flexibility with some odd ball glasses, bowls and storage ware. The new design limits some of this as the rows are fixed and the stability of objects placed upright is not as good. Stemware in the older model was easily accommodated by a slotted holder that folded down over a section of the row and held the wine glasses in nicely. The bottom tray, of the newer model is spacious and one of the only drawbacks to the silverware holder/basket is that the top of it is always still wet even after extended drying function. Our one other chief quirk is the lack/removal of the countdown clock on the front display of the old model . We were limiting ourselves to a white replacement and would have opted for a higher model if available in white . On the plus side the new unit is very quiet and does a good job of cleaning and sanitizing . We would still choose Kitchenaid products in the future

Sentence (English): I gave a 1-star rating primarily because of the poor customer service we have received to date, not necessarily the overall product quality -- the occasional manufacturer defect is not unheard of.
Comments (English): [ Defective product, terrible service ] || ---------------- || I gave a 1-star rating primarily because of the poor customer service we have received to date, not necessarily the overall product quality -- the occasional manufacturer defect is not unheard of. Six+ weeks after installation, we still don't have a properly working dishwasher. It worked for about 3 washes then the pump started making a growling/grinding noise. Called Costco Concierge services, they said it might be an installation problem. They called the installer to schedule an appointment -- we live in a city with a population of 100,000+ but the installer is 2 hours away and will only come out once a week. The installer no-showed for the first appointment with no communication, we called the next day and they said they would be back the following week. Three hours after the end of the appointment window (approximately 8:45 pm), I missed a phone call from a random individual's number. They did not call back or leave a message and the installer never showed for the second appointment. I called the installer back the following day and they said since we didn't answer the phone they cancelled the appointment. The person who I spoke to was rude and condescending and said it was our fault for not answering "multiple" phone calls. We had to go out of town so the installer scheduled a THIRD appointment two weeks later. They finally did show up for that appointment, both installer reps barely spoke English, and it took approximately 3 minutes for them to tell us what we already knew, it was not installation problem but a mechanical issue that would require a service technician. So we called Kitchenaid directly, who was very helpful, but again their technicians were 2 hours away and could only come out once a week. The service tech communicated well and was on time, again it took about 5 minutes to determine that the sump assembly needed to be replaced and that he would be back the following week to make the repair unless there was a delay in ordering the part. A week later, after hearing nothing back from the repair company, I called and they said the part was supposed to be shipped to my house then I needed to call them back to schedule an appointment. To top it all off, the dishwasher price dropped by $200 but it was just past 30 days since we made the purchase so Costco would not price match. Apart from the faulty (noisy) pump, the capacity/rack configuration is amazing and it does a great job of cleaning dishes. Bottom line - unless you live in a major metropolitan area (e.g. Nashville/Birmingham/Atlanta), I do NOT recommend anyone purchase appliances from Costco that need installation or in-house service.

I called the installer back the following day and they said since we didn't answer the phone they cancelled the appointment.  The person who I spoke to was rude and condescending and said it was our fault for not answering 'multiple' phone calls.  We had to go out of town so the installer scheduled a THIRD appointment two weeks later.  They finally did show up for that appointment, both installer reps barely spoke English, and it took approximately 3 minutes for them to tell us what we already knew, it was not installation problem but a mechanical issue that would require a service technician.  So we called Kitchenaid directly, who was very helpful, but again their technicians were 2 hours away and could only come out once a week.  The service tech communicated well and was on time, again it took about 5 minutes to determine that the sump assembly needed to be replaced and that he would be back the following week to make the repair unless there was a delay in ordering the part.  A week later, after hearing nothing back from the repair company, I called and they said the part was supposed to be shipped to my house then I needed to call them back to schedule an appointment.  To top it all off, the dishwasher price dropped by $200 but it was just past 30 days since we made the purchase so Costco would not price match.  Apart from the faulty (noisy) pump, the capacity/rack configuration is amazing and it does a great job of cleaning dishes. Bottom line - unless you live in a major metropolitan area (e.g. Nashville/Birmingham/Atlanta), I do NOT recommend anyone purchase appliances from Costco that need installation or in-house service.

Sentence (English): I have owned this dishwasher for over a month.
Comments (English): [ Mostly a Good Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I have owned this dishwasher for over a month. When it was delivered there was standing water inside the unit that had soaked all the manuals inside and had a strong mildewy smell. During the installation process, this water leaked everywhere as the installation requires you to put the diswasher on it's back, etc. This was smelly and very messy. After installation, I ran the first cycle empty assuming the smell would go away once it had cycled through. I was wrong! I have since used the "Affresh" dishwasher cleaner multiple times trying to eliminate the smell. My "clean" dishes come out smelling like old water, and the mildew smell still has not gone away. The dishwasher is quiet, seems efficient and dishes "appear" very clean. Having the third rack for large utensils is convenient. However, I am not happy about the residual smell inside.

Sentence (English): The vent in the bottom left corner lets heat out that peels the print shield finish almost immediately.
Comments (English): [ 1 star is too many for this dishwasher and service ] || ---------------- || The vent in the bottom left corner lets heat out that peels the print shield finish almost immediately. I purchased this product in Sept 2022 as I was having a new kitchen built and knew there was a delay in appliances. The dishwasher was delivered Oct 20 2022 but not installed until March 10th which I have proof of. After about 5 weeks of use the heat coming from that bottom vent on the left hand side has started to peel the print shield off, as you can see in the photo ONLY THAT CORNER. When I emailed with kitchenaid on May 10th about this problem I was repeatedly told this is a cosmetic defect something that only has warranty for 30 days. I told them it was not cosmetic and the damage can be seen from where the vent is. I was then told by a supervisor Max employee ID 3449 that this type of thing typically happens when a chair brushes up against a surface. I can assure kitchenaid that I do not have any chairs anywhere near my dishwasher nor any other object. They also suggested that maybe I have used the wrong cleaner on it. I have not had this long enough to even need a cleaner on the front surface. These comments are ludicrous as you can see from the photo exactly where the problem is happening and it is evident what would be causing this. I got bounced around between 5 different people, none of which even spoke to me like a human, I was treated like a transaction who was being denied any type of warranty or solution for this defect. I am completely disappointed with Kitchenaids customer service, values on their product and 100% will never buy anything from them again. I am extremely disappointed and who someone reads this review and will think twice about kitchenaid as a brand.

Comments (English): [ Very disappointed. Should have waited for a Bosch ] || ---------------- || I wanted to upgrade from a builder grade GE dishwasher. Have had great experiences with Bosch in the past but none were available. The appliance store recommended this Kitchen Aid because we wanted something very quiet. I also really wanted the 3rd row for silverware because I really liked that feature on the Bosch I had in my old house. My husband is a retired plumber and has installed hundreds if not thousands of dishwashers. He was astounded at how poorly engineered this dishwasher was and how difficult it was to do a quality installation. Once installed, I was anxious to try it out. On the plus side, it is very quiet and does an adequate job of cleaning the dishes. On the down side, I've had this dishwasher for over a month now, and I have yet to come up with a good placement for my dishes. Nothing seems to fit well. The racks are poorly designed, preventing a good fit for the dishes. The third row for silverware is also poorly designed and doesn't hold the silverware at a good angle. Due to this collective poor design, I can't really load the dishwasher adequately and fully and find myself running it more frequently just so I don't have to deal with the frustration. When we have company or host a holiday, it's going to be a real problem. I wish there was a way to know this stuff ahead of time. I never would have purchased this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Hi everyone, I am reviewing the Samsung French door fridge.
Comments (English): [ Pinched Water Drain Line During Manufacturing ] || ---------------- || Hi everyone, I am reviewing the Samsung French door fridge. From my personal experience and speaking to a fridge repair technician, the Samsung fridge manufacturing process has a tendency to cause a pinched water drain line. This can occur when spraying the insulation in the back of the fridge. Months after receiving the fridge and during the warranty period, I noticed that water was collecting under the crisper drawer. I had the repairman come twice during the warranty period and the issue was not resolved, but rather dismissed as nothing could be done. Whereas, the repairman should have identified it as a warranty claim and a new fridge provided. Over time, the water drain line became fully blocked and I now have to towel water out daily from under the crisper drawer. Therefore, the crisper drawer has been permanently removed to do this. I thus have to now look for a new fridge. A different repair technician confirmed that it is not repairable and water should never be collecting in the fridge if properly manufactured. Samsung was not interested in the issue as it is now beyond the warranty period, although it was raised during the warranty period. The latest repairman recommended the LG fridge in order the avoid this issue that he has come across with similar Samsung fridges.

Comments (English): [ My Expensive New Kitchen Water Feature ] || ---------------- || I purchased the unit a month ago, from Lowes home improvement at a great price compared to Home Depot, only to find out that the ratings posted certainly did not apply to my machine. The dishwasher leaked badly from day one. I checked the installation several times and removed the kick plate to find that the water was leaking from the front of the door near the hinges during the wash cycle. 4 service calls, a new inner door seal, escalation to Whirlpool's Customer Care dept., and 2 calls between the technician and Whirlpool technical support ended up with the contracted technician verifying my installation and confirming that the unit is leaking from around the door hinges, while the Whirlpool Technical Support specialist and their Escalation Representative logged the problem as incorrectly loaded dishes. SERIOUSLY? There were 10 cups and a few bowls in the unit at the time. But the 2 people who were not there, made the diagnosis! The unit leaks EVERY time I use it. With no dishes, a few dishes or completely loaded. There are numerous write ups for this issue with this model on Whirlpool's own website. The surrounding cabinets are now damaged due to the water leaks and I have submitted a consumer protection claim to my state's Attorney General's office to help me handle the matter. Meanwhile Whirlpool stands fast that it is a user error. The contracted technician is scheduled to come out one more time and bring a "clear" door with them to observe the water jet flow. I am not a mechanical engineer, but I assume that we will discover that water is indeed spraying around inside of the machine. Imagine that? BOTTOM LINE Whirlpool wants to take a hard line stance that their product has passed rigorous testing and quality control, but then will not stand behind the customer when there is an obvious issue. I would not recommend this dishwasher to anyone. The product is awful, Whirlpool Customer Service is professional and nice but ineffective, and Whirlpool technical support is completely useless and simply reading from a script to make the customer go away. I will provide an update when this gets resolved to my satisfaction. Frustrated but unwilling to give up!
